name: Footwork: First Position
pose: lies supine on the carriage with the back of her head on the headrest and her pelvis neutral, both legs extended toward the footbar with her heels resting on the bar, feet parallel and hip-width apart, toes lifted so the soles face up the reformer, knees soft and very slightly turned out, arms long and relaxed at her sides on the carriage. The carriage is pressed away toward the foot end of the frame.
highlight: the quadriceps and hamstrings of both thighs and the inner-thigh adductors, with the hip external rotators at the back of the hips

name: Footwork: Monkey on a Branch
pose: lies supine on the carriage, pelvis neutral, both legs extended with only the balls of her feet on the footbar and her heels lifted high above the bar, feet parallel and close together, toes gripping the bar, knees soft. Her arms rest at her sides and the carriage is pressed out.
highlight: the quadriceps and hamstrings of both thighs and the small intrinsic muscles of the feet and the calves

name: Footwork: Parallel Heels
pose: lies supine on the carriage, pelvis neutral, both legs extended with her heels hooked over the footbar and her feet flexed hard so the toes pull back toward her shins, feet parallel and hip-width apart, knees soft. Arms relaxed at her sides, carriage pressed out.
highlight: the quadriceps and hamstrings of both thighs and the dorsiflexors along the front of the shins

name: Footwork: Parallel Toes
pose: lies supine on the carriage, pelvis neutral, both legs extended with the balls of her feet on the footbar and her heels lifted directly above the bar in a high releve, feet parallel and hip-width apart, ankles strong, knees soft. Arms relaxed at her sides, carriage pressed out.
highlight: the quadriceps and hamstrings of both thighs, the calves and the muscles of the feet

name: Footwork: Internal Rotation
pose: lies supine on the carriage, pelvis neutral, both legs extended with her heels on the footbar turned inward so the toes point toward each other in a pigeon-toed V, knees falling slightly in toward each other, inner thighs squeezing. Arms relaxed at her sides, carriage pressed out.
highlight: the quadriceps and hamstrings of both thighs and the hip internal rotators and inner thighs

name: Footwork: Calf Raises
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both legs extended and the balls of her feet on the footbar, feet parallel and hip-width apart, knees straight and carriage held still while her heels press down below the level of the bar then lift into a tall releve. Arms relaxed at her sides.
highlight: the calves, especially the gastrocnemius and soleus bellies, and the quadriceps of both thighs

name: Footwork: Combined Tendon Stretch
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both legs extended and the balls of her feet on the footbar, heels lifted in a tall releve, both knees bent to draw the carriage toward her seat while her heels stay high, then legs pressed straight again. Arms relaxed at her sides.
highlight: the plantar flexors of the calves and feet, with the quadriceps and hamstrings of both thighs

name: Footwork: Single Leg on Heel and Toes
pose: holds her near knee bent to ninety degrees, that thigh vertical and that shin horizontal and level with the floor in a table shape, with that foot floating in the air above the carriage. She lies flat on her back and face up with arms by her sides, and her other heel rests on the centre of the footbar with that leg almost straight, the carriage pushed out toward the foot end. The bent knee stays bent throughout, and that shin never points up at the ceiling. She is not face down, not in a plank and not propped on her hands.
highlight: the quadriceps and hamstrings of the working leg on the bar, plus the deep obliques and multifidus of the waist

name: Footwork: Sleeper
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both legs extended low and long toward the footbar, one heel resting lightly on the bar with the other leg lifted slightly above it, pelvis neutral and legs almost parallel to the carriage. Arms relaxed at her sides.
highlight: the upper hamstrings and the lower glutes of the working leg, with the gluteus medius and the abdominals

name: Footwork: Ballet Combination
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both legs turned out in a ballet first position, heels together and toes apart on the footbar, one leg then extending long while the other stays bent, pelvis level. Arms rest softly at her sides.
highlight: the quadriceps and plantar flexors of the calves, the inner-thigh adductors and the hamstrings

name: Supine: Chicken Wings
pose: lies flat on her back, face up, a strap handle in each hand. Her arms make a goalpost shape: upper arms straight out at shoulder height and level with the carriage, elbows bent to ninety degrees so both forearms point straight up at the ceiling. From the side the near forearm stands upright above its elbow and the far arm mirrors it. The straps run back to the pulleys. She is not face down, not kneeling and not on a box.
highlight: the pectorals across the chest and the front of the shoulders, with the abdominals engaged to hold the ribs down

name: Supine: Lat Pulls
pose: lies supine on the carriage holding a strap handle in each hand, both arms reaching up to the ceiling then angled back over her head with the elbows softly bent, pulling the straps down toward her hips in a long arc, ribs knitted and lower back quiet, legs long on the carriage.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi sweeping down both sides of the back, with the abdominals stabilising the trunk

name: Supine: Angels
pose: lies flat on her back, face up, straight arms sweeping in a wide snow-angel arc from her hips toward her head, her hands staying low and about level with the carriage. This is the middle of the arc: her arms are halfway between straight out to the sides and straight overhead, palms up. She is not sitting, not rolled onto her side and not reaching up to the ceiling.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi, teres minor, infraspinatus and rear deltoids, with the abdominals and the serratus anterior along the ribs

name: Supine: Triceps Press
pose: lies flat on her back, face up, head on the raised headrest, both legs long and together on the carriage, a strap handle in each hand. Her upper arms are pinned flat on the carriage beside her ribs and her elbows are bent sharply so her hands are up by her shoulders. The straps run back over her shoulders to the pulleys. This is the start position, just before she presses down. She is not sitting up, not kneeling and not face down.
highlight: the triceps on the back of both upper arms, with the shoulder stabilisers

name: Supine: The Hundred
pose: lies supine on the carriage with her head, neck and shoulder blades curled up off the carriage, both legs lifted into a tabletop or extended long at a low angle, arms straight and low beside her hips pumping up and down in small rapid beats while holding the straps.
highlight: the whole abdominal wall, the hip flexors at the front of the hips, the deep neck flexors under the chin and the latissimus dorsi

name: Supine: Frog Extensions
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops, heels pressed together and knees drawn wide open into a diamond, then both legs press diagonally up and away until almost straight, pelvis glued level on the carriage, arms long at her sides.
highlight: the inner-thigh adductors, the quadriceps, hamstrings and hip external rotators, with the abdominals holding the spine neutral

name: Supine: True Levitation
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and both knees bent, then the pelvis is rolled up off the carriage so the lower back and hips lift into the air, legs held in a bent tabletop above her, weight resting on the upper back and shoulders.
highlight: the abdominals, the glutes and the inner thighs working together to lift and hold the pelvis

name: Supine: Short Spine Stretch
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops, legs overhead and knees bent toward her face, then the pelvis rolls up and over so the spine peels off the carriage vertebra by vertebra while the legs lower toward her head, then the spine rolls back down bone by bone and the legs extend away.
highlight: the glutes, abdominals and inner thighs, with the spinal extensors lengthening

name: Supine: Coordination
straps: both feet in the foot straps and a handle in each hand
pose: lies supine on the carriage with her head and shoulders curled up, both feet in the strap loops with the legs bent in a tabletop, and a strap handle in each hand held with elbows bent beside her ribs, then one leg extends long while the arms straighten in opposition. The trunk stays lifted.
highlight: the abdominals, hip flexors, the deep neck flexors and the triceps of both arms

name: Supine: Overhead
straps: both feet in the foot straps and a handle in each hand
pose: lies supine on the carriage in a deep articulation with the pelvis lifted and the legs carrying up and over her head toward the floor behind her, arms pressing long straight straps down alongside her body toward her hips, the whole body folded into a small tight arc.
highlight: the abdominals, the latissimus dorsi and the triceps, with the spine lengthening through the roll

name: Supine: Overhead to Jackknife
nameEs: Por encima de la cabeza/La navaja
straps: both feet in the foot straps and a handle in each hand
pose: lies supine on the carriage with the body folded overhead and the legs vertical above her hips in a jackknife, pelvis lifted high so the weight is on the upper back, arms pressing the straps down beside her, legs reaching straight for the ceiling.
highlight: the abdominals, hip flexors, latissimus dorsi and triceps holding the folded position

name: Rowing: Hug a Tree
pose: sits tall cross-legged on the carriage facing the pulley end, a strap handle in each hand, arms opened wide to the sides at shoulder height with softly bent elbows, then the arms sweep forward and together to wrap the straps around an invisible tree in front of her chest, sitting bones grounded and spine long.
highlight: the deltoids and pectorals across the chest and front of the shoulders, with the abdominals and the scapular stabilisers between the shoulder blades

name: Rowing: Military Salute
pose: sits tall cross-legged on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, one arm bent with the hand brought to her forehead in a military salute while the other arm presses long and straight down beside her hip. Torso upright, ribs knitted.
highlight: the triceps of the pressing arm, the deltoids of both shoulders and the back extensors holding her upright

name: Rowing: Modified Front Rowing
pose: sits tall cross-legged on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, arms extended forward at chest height, drawing the handles back with high elbows out to the sides as the shoulder blades squeeze together, then releasing forward again. Spine stays vertical.
highlight: the deltoids, the middle trapezius and rhomboids between the shoulder blades, the serratus anterior and the abdominals

name: Rowing: Front Rowing
pose: sits tall cross-legged on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, moving through a flowing sequence of arms reaching forward, pulling wide, lifting overhead and sweeping down. Torso stays tall and still through the whole circular pattern.
highlight: the shoulder stabilisers all around the shoulder joint, the latissimus dorsi along the back and the erector spinae

name: Rowing: Back Rowing, Round Back
pose: sits cross-legged on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, spine rounded forward into a long C-curve with her head dropped and her ribs drawn in, arms rowing the handles back beside her waist and then releasing forward again from the rounded shape.
highlight: the shoulder stabilisers, the abdominals holding the rounded shape and the erector spinae lengthening along the back

name: Rowing: Back Rowing, Flat Back Hinge
pose: sits cross-legged on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, hinging forward from the hip with a completely flat back and a long neck, arms rowing the handles back alongside her waist, then returning upright with the same flat spine.
highlight: the shoulder stabilisers, the erector spinae along the whole spine and the abdominals, with the hamstrings lengthening

name: Long Box: Chest Expansion
pose: lies face down along the long box with her chest just past the front edge, holding a strap handle in each hand, arms long and slightly behind her hips, chest and head lifted as the straight arms draw the straps back and down beside her body, legs together and still on the box.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi, triceps and rear deltoids, with the scapular stabilisers between the shoulder blades and the abdominals supporting the lift

name: Long Box: The Croix
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest lifted, holding a strap handle in each hand, both arms opened wide out to the sides at shoulder height in a T shape, then the bent elbows draw the straps in toward her ribs in a cross shape, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Legs long on the box.
highlight: the rhomboids and middle trapezius between the shoulder blades, with the rear deltoids and the shoulder stabilisers

name: Long Box: Rotator
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest lifted, holding a strap handle in each hand, both upper arms pinned close to her ribs with the elbows bent to 90 degrees and the forearms pointing forward, then the forearms rotate outward and up away from the box in external rotation. Legs still on the box.
highlight: the external rotators of the shoulder — infraspinatus and teres minor at the back of each shoulder — with the postural muscles and abdominals

name: Long Box: The Queen
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest lifted, holding a strap handle in each hand, both arms bent into an elegant W with the elbows high and the hands beside her head, then the arms sweep down and forward into a long low V reaching past her hips. Ribs stay lifted off the box.
highlight: the serratus anterior wrapping the ribs and the anterior deltoids, with the abdominals holding the chest lifted

name: Long Box: Pulling the Ropes
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest lifted, holding a strap handle in each hand, alternately pulling one straight arm back past her hip while the other reaches forward, in a strong rope-climbing rhythm. Legs long and quiet on the box.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi and the shoulder stabilisers, alternating through both sides of the back

name: Long Box: The T
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest and head lifted in a long neutral extension, holding a strap handle in each hand, arms reaching down toward the floor then opening wide out to the sides into a big T at shoulder height, palms turning down. Legs long on the box.
highlight: the thoracic extensors, rear deltoids, latissimus dorsi and lower trapezius

name: Long Box: Triceps
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest lifted, holding a strap handle in each hand, both upper arms pinned tight alongside her ribs with the elbows bent and the hands under her chest, then the elbows straighten to press the straps back behind her hips. Legs still on the box.
highlight: the triceps on the back of both upper arms, with the shoulder stabilisers and the back extensors

name: Long Box: Backstroke
pose: lies face down on the long box with her chest lifted, holding a strap handle in each hand, one straight arm sweeping down past her hip then lifting up and over in a large backstroke circle to reach forward again while the other arm follows. Torso lifted and steady.
highlight: the triceps and the thoracic extensors, with the shoulder stabilisers moving through their full range

name: Long Box: Balance Point
pose: balances face down on the long box pivoted on her hip bones, chest and head lifted, both legs lifted long behind her, and both arms reaching forward holding a strap handle in each hand, holding a long arched banana shape above the box.
highlight: the abdominals and the shoulder flexors, with the scapular stabilisers and the back extensors holding the balance

name: Long Box: Teaser
pose: sits facing away from the pulleys at the front end of the long box, legs lifted together and long at about 45 degrees, torso leaning back into a high V, both arms reaching forward parallel to her legs holding the strap handles, in a perfect balanced teaser shape.
highlight: the abdominals and hip flexors, the latissimus dorsi, the inner thighs and the lower glutes, with the deep neck flexors

name: Long Box: Teaser, the Dying Swan
pose: is lowering slowly from a balanced teaser shape seated on the long box, legs long and lifted together, torso reclining back toward the box with the spine rounding segment by segment and arms sweeping overhead, in a slow controlled descent.
highlight: the abdominals and hip flexors working eccentrically, with the latissimus dorsi, adductors and lower glutes

name: Long Box: Hamstring Curl
straps: straps hooked around both ankles or heels
pose: lies face down on the long box with her hips at the front edge and her legs hanging long off the end toward the pulleys, straps hooked around her ankles, then both knees bend to draw her heels up toward her seat against the spring while her hips stay pressed down on the box.
highlight: the hamstrings and glutes of both legs, and the inner thighs when the legs work in parallel

name: Long Box: Charlie Chaplin
straps: straps hooked around both ankles or heels
pose: lies face down on the long box with her hips at the edge and legs hanging off the end, both legs turned out from the hips with the heels together and the toes apart, knees bending in small turned-out circles to draw the carriage, like a comedic little walk.
highlight: the hamstrings and glutes, the six deep hip rotators and the inner thighs

name: Long Box: Swimming
pose: lies face down on the long box holding a strap handle in each hand, chest and both legs lifted off the box, alternately fluttering one arm and the opposite leg up and down in a small fast swimming beat, head long and neck relaxed.
highlight: the glutes and hamstrings of both legs and the spinal extensors along the back, with the middle and lower trapezius and the abdominals

name: Long Box: Swan Dive
pose: lies face down on the long box in a deep swan arch, chest and head high, both legs lifted long behind her, arms sweeping out and back like wings holding the strap handles, the whole body rocking forward and back in a long banana curve.
highlight: the spinal extensors along the whole back, with the shoulder stabilisers, triceps and abdominals

name: Long Box: Grasshopper
pose: lies face down on the long box propped on her forearms, chest lifted, both knees bent with the soles of her feet turned up toward the ceiling, then the bent legs lift and beat together with a small external rotation at the hips. Head stays long.
highlight: the spinal extensors, glutes and hip external rotators, with the shoulder stabilisers, triceps and abdominals

name: Roll Downs
pose: sits tall cross-legged on the long box facing away from the pulleys holding a strap handle in each hand near her shoulders, then curls her chin and rolls her spine down one vertebra at a time toward the box with her arms reaching forward, before rolling back up to sitting.
highlight: the abdominals through the whole roll, with the deep spinal muscles lengthening and the scapular stabilisers

name: Roll Down: Reverse Teaser
pose: starts lying back on the long box with legs lifted, then rolls the spine up segment by segment to sitting while the legs lower toward the box and the arms reach forward, arriving in an upright seated shape with legs long.
highlight: the abdominals and hip flexors, with the segmental spinal muscles and the scapular stabilisers

name: Roll Down: Mermaid
pose: faces the viewer — the only exercise drawn that way — while the reformer itself stays side-on. She sits sideways on the long box with both legs folded to one side, so the side bend reads as a crescent shape. Her arm nearest the pulleys holds a single strap and reaches up and over her head, and her body bends away from the pulleys in one long curve from hip to fingertips. Her other hand rests on the box. She is not cross-legged and not rowing.
highlight: the quadratus lumborum and the internal and external obliques along the side waist, with the latissimus dorsi, pectorals and triceps

name: Long Stretch
pose: stands on the carriage in a straight high plank with both hands on the footbar, shoulders stacked directly over her wrists, body a long straight line from heels to head, hips level, then presses the carriage away and draws it back without letting the hips sag or lift.
highlight: the abdominals, the shoulders and chest, and the glutes holding the plank line

name: Long Stretch: Up Stretch
pose: stands on the balls of her feet on the carriage with both hands on the footbar, hips stacked high over her heels in an inverted V pike, back rounded and head dropped between her arms, pressing the carriage away and drawing it back with the hips staying lifted.
highlight: the abdominals and the scapular stabilisers, with the shoulders and the ankles working to hold the shape

name: Long Stretch: Around the World, High Stretch
pose: stands on the carriage in a high pike with hands on the footbar, then one arm releases and sweeps out and up in a large circle around her head while the other arm supports her, the torso staying lifted and the hips high.
highlight: the pectorals, serratus anterior, latissimus dorsi and abdominals, with the spinal extensors, hamstrings and glutes

name: Long Stretch: Down Stretch
pose: stands with both hands on the footbar and her chest lowered close to her knees in a deep rounded forward fold, hips high and heels down on the carriage, the chest pressing toward the bar as the carriage travels away.
highlight: the chest and front of the shoulders opening, with the latissimus dorsi, abdominals, erector spinae, hamstrings and glutes

name: Long Stretch: Arabesque
pose: stands on one leg on the carriage with both hands on the footbar, torso long and level over the bar, the other leg lifted straight behind her to hip height in a turned-out arabesque, then presses the carriage away and draws it back on the standing leg.
highlight: the gluteus maximus, hamstrings and hip external rotators of the lifted leg, with the scapular stabilisers, abdominals, spinal extensors and hip flexors

name: Long Stretch: Interflora
pose: stands on one leg on the carriage with both hands on the footbar, the other leg lifted straight behind then swept out to the side and across behind her in a wide arc while the torso stays level, then the leg returns.
highlight: the abdominals and hip flexors, with the scapular stabilisers, hamstrings, quadriceps and glutes of both legs

name: Elephant: Flat Back
pose: stands upright on the carriage with both feet flat and close together, then folds forward at the hips and pushes her hips far back and up so her torso becomes a long horizontal table, back completely flat and parallel to the carriage, arms reaching straight forward and down with locked-out straight elbows so both hands grip the padded footbar. Her hips are the highest point of her body, stacked high above her heels, her head and neck continue the straight line of her spine without dropping, and both knees are straight. This is a deep forward hinge, NOT a plank, NOT a push-up and NOT a hover: her straight arms stay planted on the footbar while the carriage slides away from her under her feet.
highlight: the hip flexors and the shoulder stabilisers, with the lower abdominals, the dorsiflexors of the shins and the hamstrings lengthening

name: Elephant: Round Back
pose: stands on the carriage with both feet flat and close together, then folds forward at the hips with her hips pushed far back and up, spine rounded into a long deep C-curve, so her head hangs dropped and heavy between her straight arms while both hands grip the padded footbar. Her hips are the highest point, stacked over her heels, her arms are straight and planted on the footbar, and both knees are straight. This is a deep rounded forward fold, NOT a plank and NOT a push-up: her arms stay planted on the footbar while the carriage slides away from her under her feet.
highlight: the abdominals holding the round shape, with the shoulder stabilisers, hip flexors and dorsiflexors, and the spine and hamstrings lengthening

name: Long Stretch: Forward Fold Stretch
pose: stands with both feet on the carriage, folds forward from the hips over straight legs with her hands resting lightly on the footbar or the frame, spine long and neck completely released, hips drawing back as the carriage travels.
highlight: the hamstrings along the back of both thighs and the spinal extensors lengthening, with the neck released

name: Long Stretch: Long Back Stretch
pose: kneels on the carriage with both hands on the footbar, hips drawn far back over her heels and her chest lowered toward the bar, arms straight and long, spine stretched into a long flat line as the carriage travels away and returns.
highlight: the triceps and latissimus dorsi, with the glutes, abdominals, scapular stabilisers and spinal extensors

name: Stomach Massage: Round Back
pose: sits on the front edge of the carriage facing the footbar with both feet flat on the bar, knees bent and heels together, her spine rounded into a long C-curve with the head dropped forward and both hands resting on the frame beside her hips, pressing the carriage away with the legs.
highlight: the abdominals holding the rounded shape, with the quadriceps and glutes of both legs and the erector spinae lengthening

name: Stomach Massage: Flat Back
pose: sits on the front edge of the carriage facing the footbar with both feet flat on the bar and knees bent, her spine completely upright and flat with the chest open and head tall, both hands resting on the frame beside her hips as she presses the carriage away.
highlight: the spinal extensors and psoas holding her upright, with the abdominals, scapular stabilisers and quadriceps

name: Stomach Massage: Reach
pose: sits tall on the carriage facing the footbar with feet flat on the bar and knees bent, one or both arms reaching long and high overhead in a tall diagonal, lifting out of the waist as the carriage travels away, chest broad and spine long.
highlight: the spinal extensors, the abdominals in their lengthened position and the psoas holding the seated shape, with the chest and shoulder stabilisers

name: Stomach Massage: Bouquet of Flowers
pose: sits on the carriage facing the footbar with feet on the bar, both arms reaching forward and rounded as though gathering a big bouquet of flowers against her chest, spine curled around the imaginary bundle, then the arms open and sweep wide.
highlight: the abdominals and obliques, with the chest, front of the shoulders and the scapular stabilisers

name: Stomach Massage: Psoas Stretch
pose: sits tall on the carriage facing the footbar with both feet on the bar, then twists from the ribcage so one hand reaches across and back while the torso stays long and vertical, pelvis square and still, opening the front of one hip.
highlight: the spinal extensors and lengthened abdominals, the internal and external obliques and quadratus lumborum, and the hip flexors and quadriceps of the trailing leg

name: Knee Stretch: Scooter
pose: stands on the floor beside the footbar facing the foot end of the reformer, her standing knee soft. She hinges forward with a flat back and both hands on the bar. Her working foot is on the carriage behind her, braced against the shoulder block, pushing the carriage back. She is not kneeling: one foot is on the carriage and one is on the floor.
highlight: the gluteus maximus, hamstrings and quadriceps of the working leg, with the hip flexors of the back leg lengthening

name: Knee Stretch: Flat Back
pose: kneels on the carriage facing the footbar with both hands on the bar, both knees on the carriage hip-width apart, spine perfectly flat and parallel to the carriage with the head long, hips travelling straight back and forward over her knees.
highlight: the spinal extensors and psoas, with the scapular stabilisers, the quadriceps and the lower abdominals

name: Knee Stretch: Round Back
pose: kneels on the carriage facing the footbar with both hands on the bar, both knees down hip-width apart, her spine rounded into a long C-curve with the head dropped, hips travelling back over her heels and forward again.
highlight: the scapular stabilisers, quadriceps and lower abdominals, with the spinal extensors lengthening

name: Knee Stretch: Knees Off
pose: kneels on the carriage facing the footbar with both hands on the bar, both knees lifted a few centimetres off the carriage so her weight is carried on her hands and thighs, back arched long and hips travelling back and forward.
highlight: the spinal extensors and hip flexors, with the scapular stabilisers, quadriceps and lower abdominals

name: Reverse Knee Stretch: Round Back
pose: sits on the carriage facing away from the footbar with both feet flat against the bar, knees bent, both hands gripping the carriage edge behind her hips, spine rounded and chest curled forward over her knees, pressing the carriage away with the legs.
highlight: the abdominals holding the rounded shape, with the shoulder stabilisers and the spinal extensors lengthening

name: Reverse Knee Stretch: Flat Back and Obliques
pose: sits on the carriage facing away from the footbar with both feet against the bar and knees bent, hands behind her on the carriage, torso leaning back at an angle with the spine flat and long, then twisting the ribcage to one side and the other as the legs press.
highlight: the abdominals and both sets of obliques, with the shoulder stabilisers and the spinal extensors

name: Kneeling: Chest Expansion
pose: kneels upright on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, arms long and slightly behind her hips with straight elbows, drawing the straps back and down as her chest opens and her shoulders roll back, hips stacked over her knees.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi, triceps and rotator cuff, with the hamstrings, glutes and abdominals holding her upright

name: Kneeling: The Croix and Rotator
pose: kneels upright on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, both arms opened wide to the sides then drawn in with bent elbows in a cross, followed by external rotation with the upper arms pinned to her ribs, torso tall and still.
highlight: the rhomboids and middle trapezius between the shoulder blades and the shoulder external rotators, with the postural muscles and abdominals

name: Kneeling: Arm Circles
pose: kneels upright on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, both straight arms sweeping through big slow circles beside her body, one direction then the other, while the torso stays completely still and vertical.
highlight: the deltoids and scapular stabilisers, with the abdominals, glutes and hamstrings holding the kneel steady

name: Kneeling: The Offering
pose: kneels upright on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, both arms sweeping forward and offering the handles away in front of her in a long reach, with a side bend through the waist so the gesture curves slightly to one side.
highlight: the shoulders and the obliques along the waist, with the abdominals, glutes and hamstrings holding the kneel

name: Kneeling: Military Salute
pose: kneels upright on the carriage facing the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand, one arm pressing long and straight down beside her hip while the other bends with the hand brought to her forehead in a salute, torso still and tall.
highlight: the triceps and deltoids, with the abdominals, glutes, hamstrings and middle trapezius holding the upright kneel

name: Kneeling: Knee Opening Backbend
pose: kneels on the carriage facing away from the pulley end holding a strap handle in each hand behind her, arching back into a long backbend with her chest lifted toward the ceiling and her hips pressing forward over her knees, arms drawing the straps down behind her.
highlight: the glutes and lumbar extensors, with the shoulders, arms, chest and latissimus dorsi opening

name: Side Kneeling: Overhead
straps: one handle in the far hand
pose: kneels side-on to the pulley end on the carriage, torso facing sideways with one hand holding the far strap and lifting the straight arm up and over her head in a long arc, the other hand resting on her hip, torso held level and square.
highlight: the shoulder of the working arm and the latissimus dorsi, with the abdominals, side obliques and glutes keeping her stable

name: Side Kneeling: Single Arm Rotator
straps: one handle in the far hand
pose: kneels side-on to the pulley end on the carriage, one upper arm pinned against her ribs with the elbow bent to 90 degrees, forearm rotating outward against the strap in external rotation while her torso stays square and upright.
highlight: the shoulder abductors and external rotators of the working arm, with the abdominals and glutes keeping the trunk still

name: Side Kneeling: Lunge Thrust
straps: one handle in the far hand
pose: kneels side-on to the pulley end on the carriage holding the far strap, then thrusts the straight arm forward and across her body in a fencing lunge, torso rotating with the press while the hips stay anchored over her knees.
highlight: the front of the shoulder and chest of the working arm, with the abdominals, obliques and glutes resisting the rotation

name: Side Kneeling: Painting Under the Ladder
straps: one handle in the far hand
pose: kneels side-on to the pulley end on the carriage holding the far strap, arm reaching out and sweeping down in a low lateral arc as though painting the floor under a low ladder, wrist and hand leading the movement, torso side-bending slightly to follow.
highlight: the deltoids and shoulder stabilisers of the working arm, with the obliques along the waist and the forearm and wrist

name: Legs in Straps: Leg Pull, Parallel
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and legs together in parallel, pressing down toward the carriage and then drawing the legs back up toward her chest one at a time or together, pelvis absolutely level and still.
highlight: the hamstrings drawing the legs home and the adductors holding the legs together, with the abdominals and deep spinal muscles stabilising the pelvis

name: Legs in Straps: Leg Pull, External and Internal Rotation
nameEs: Pull de piernas en rotación externa/interna
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops, legs turned out from the hips in external rotation then rotated in to parallel and back, pressing the legs down and drawing them up while the pelvis stays glued level.
highlight: the hamstrings, adductors and the deep hip rotators, with the abdominals stabilising the pelvis

name: Legs in Straps: Open and Close
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and legs lifted straight up, opening the legs wide out to the sides in a V then squeezing them firmly back together, pelvis level and torso still.
highlight: the inner-thigh adductors doing the closing, with the abdominals and deep spinal muscles holding the pelvis and spine still

name: Legs in Straps: Open and Close with Rotation
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and legs lifted, opening the legs wide and then closing them while rotating the legs out and in from the hips at the same time, pelvis level and trunk still.
highlight: the inner thighs and the deep hip rotators, with the hamstrings and the abdominals stabilising the pelvis

name: Legs in Straps: Rectangles, Circles and Ovals
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and legs lifted together, drawing large geometric shapes in the air with the legs — rectangles, then circles, then ovals — while the pelvis and torso stay completely still.
highlight: the hamstrings and adductors tracing the shapes, with the hip rotators and the abdominals and deep spinal stabilisers holding the pelvis still

name: Legs in Straps: Hollywood Legs
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops, head and shoulders curled up off the carriage, legs performing an intricate alternating scissor pattern — one leg crossing over the other and swapping — while the trunk stays lifted and still.
highlight: the abdominals with a strong focus on the obliques, plus the deep spinal muscles and the inner thighs

name: Legs in Straps: Diamond Leg Pulls
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and legs turned out into a diamond shape at the knees, pressing the legs up and away then drawing them back down in the turned-out position, pelvis level and still.
highlight: the hip external rotators and the hamstrings, especially the outer biceps femoris, with the abdominals stabilising

name: Long Spine Stretch
straps: both feet in the foot straps
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and legs together, lifting the hips and rolling the spine up off the carriage one vertebra at a time with the legs reaching up and over, then rolling back down bone by bone.
highlight: the glutes, hamstrings and abdominals lifting and controlling the roll, with the erector spinae lengthening

name: Triple Hip Stretch
straps: one foot in a strap, the other foot on the carriage
pose: lies supine on the carriage with one foot in a strap and that leg drawn across her body and open to the side, the other foot flat on the carriage, stretching through the hip in three directions while the pelvis stays level.
highlight: the hamstrings, inner thighs and deep hip rotators of the stretched leg, with the glutes

name: Control Front
pose: lies supine on the carriage with one foot in a strap, that leg lifted straight and then swept out wide to the side and held at its end range, the other leg long on the carriage, pelvis level and square.
highlight: the hamstrings, the iliotibial band along the outside of the thigh and the inner-thigh adductors of the working leg

name: Control Back
straps: both feet in the foot straps and a handle in each hand
pose: lies supine on the carriage with both feet in the strap loops and a handle in each hand, pressing the arms down to curl the head and shoulders up, then rolling the whole body up and over into an inverted position with the legs overhead and the arms pressing long, before unfolding slowly.
highlight: the triceps and latissimus dorsi pressing, with the hip flexors, abdominals, glutes, scapular stabilisers and inner thighs controlling the inversion

name: Short Box: Roll Down, Round Back
pose: sits upright on the short box with both feet hooked under the strap and her hands clasped lightly behind her head, then curls her chin and rolls her spine down toward the box one vertebra at a time with the back rounded, before rolling back up to sitting.
highlight: the abdominals and hip flexors through the roll, with the hip abductors and the segmental spinal muscles

name: Short Box: Hinge, Flat Back
pose: sits upright on the short box with both feet hooked under the strap and her hands behind her head, hinging back from the hips as one long flat unit with the spine completely straight, then returning upright without rounding.
highlight: the abdominals and hip flexors, with the spinal extensors and the scapular stabilisers between the shoulder blades

name: Short Box: Old Man in the Gym
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap, rolling back with a rounded spine while one arm reaches and circles overhead in an old-fashioned gym swing, the other arm assisting, torso controlling the descent.
highlight: the abdominals and obliques controlling the roll, with the shoulders and arms circling

name: Short Box: Hugging the Barrel
pose: sits upright on the short box with feet hooked under the strap and both arms reaching forward as if hugging a big barrel against her chest, twisting the ribcage to one side and then the other with the pelvis staying square and facing forward.
highlight: the obliques and quadratus lumborum through the twist, with the hip abductors and the scapular stabilisers

name: Short Box: Twist, Round Back
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap and hands behind her head, rolling the spine down with a rounded back while twisting the ribcage to one side at the bottom of the roll, then rolling up and twisting to the other side.
highlight: the obliques and abdominals doing the twist and the roll, with the hip flexors and the deep spinal muscles

name: Short Box: Spear Fishing
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap, leaning back at a low angle with both hands clasped together and thrust forward like a spear, twisting the torso side to side to stab the imaginary spear while the pelvis stays anchored.
highlight: the obliques taking the main effort, with the adductors, quadriceps, lower glutes and shoulder stabilisers

name: Short Box: Spear Fishing, Around the World
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap, leaning back low with clasped hands sweeping in a big full circle around her body from one side to the other, the torso tracing the circle while the legs stay anchored.
highlight: the obliques and quadratus lumborum, with the quadriceps, adductors, dorsiflexors and scapular stabilisers

name: Short Box: Climbing the Tree
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap, rolling down with a rounded spine and reaching both hands up overhead as if climbing a tree, then folding forward over her straight legs, alternating the reach.
highlight: the hamstrings lengthening, with the hip flexors and abdominals through the roll and the spinal extensors

name: Short Box: Side Abs
pose: sits sideways on the short box with both feet hooked under the strap and her hands behind her head, leaning back and side-bending so her ribs curl toward her hip on one side, then repeating on the other side.
highlight: the obliques and quadratus lumborum on the working side of the waist

name: Short Box: Half Circle
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap, rolling the spine down and around in a half circle so the torso circles from one side through the centre to the other, articulating each vertebra as it travels.
highlight: the glutes, hamstrings and deltoids working through the circle, with the spinal extensors articulating and the quadriceps lengthening

name: Short Box: Tendon Stretch
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap, arms reaching forward as she folds over her straight legs with her chest toward her thighs and her toes pulled back, then curls back up to sitting.
highlight: the abdominals and spinal extensors, with the hamstrings and calves stretching and the latissimus dorsi, chest and triceps

name: Short Box: Tendon Stretch, Around the World
nameEs: Estiramiento del tendón: vuelta al mundo
pose: sits on the short box with feet hooked under the strap and folds forward over her straight legs, then circles her torso around in a wide loop through one side, forward, the other side and back, travelling around the world.
highlight: the abdominals and obliques through the circle, with the spinal extensors, hamstrings, calves and latissimus dorsi

name: Short Box: Walking
pose: sits tall on the short box with feet hooked under the strap and hands behind her head, then walks her torso forward and back by shifting onto one sitting bone and then the other, alternately extending each leg, in a small seated stride.
highlight: the tensor fasciae latae and gluteus medius and minimus when the leg goes out to the side, the glutes of the trailing leg, and the abdominals, hip flexors, latissimus dorsi, chest and triceps

name: Short Box: Hip Lift
pose: lies back on the short box with both feet hooked under the strap and knees bent, then lifts her pelvis up off the box by pressing through her feet, holding the hips high with the body in a straight line or in external rotation, before lowering slowly.
highlight: the hamstrings and glutes lifting the hips, with the abdominals and the deep hip rotators in external rotation

name: Splits: Side Splits
pose: stands astride the reformer with one foot on the fixed platform and the other on the moving carriage, knees softly bent, then slides the carriage out sideways and draws it back in by squeezing her inner thighs, torso upright and square.
highlight: the hip abductors and the inner-thigh adductors of both legs, with the abdominals and the hip external rotators

name: Splits: The Hare
pose: stands in front of the reformer facing away, one foot on the carriage with the leg extended straight back and her hands on the frame, folding her torso down over her front leg in a deep hare-like front split shape.
highlight: the hamstrings and glutes of the extended back leg, with the hip flexors and quadriceps of the front leg lengthening

name: Splits: Speed Skating
pose: stands astride the reformer in a wide speed-skater stance, one foot on the platform and one on the carriage, hips sunk down and side-bending over one leg while the other slides out and back, torso low and leaning forward.
highlight: the inner-thigh adductors and the hip abductors of both legs, with the quadriceps and glutes

name: Splits: Back Splits
pose: stands facing the reformer with her front foot on the platform and her back leg extended far behind with the forefoot on the carriage, sinking into a long low back split, torso upright with the pelvis square and level.
highlight: the hamstrings, glutes and quadriceps of both legs, especially the inner vastus medialis, with the obliques and multifidus keeping the pelvis from rotating

name: Splits: Front Splits, Four Phase Stretch
nameEs: Splits de frente: estiramiento en 4 fases
pose: stands in a split stance on the reformer with the front foot on the platform and the back forefoot on the carriage, lowering progressively through four stages into a full front split with the torso upright and hands lightly on the frame.
highlight: the hip flexors of the back leg lengthening and the hamstrings of the front leg, with the glutes

name: Splits: Front Splits
pose: stands in a full front split on the reformer with the front foot on the platform and the back leg extended along the carriage, sliding deeper into the split then drawing the carriage home with the back leg, torso tall and pelvis square.
highlight: the quadriceps of the front leg and the hamstrings and glutes of the back leg, with the abdominals supporting and the hip flexors lengthening

name: Splits: Jump Preparation
pose: stands with both feet on the carriage in a parallel stance, knees softly bent, rolling slowly through the feet from heel to toe to rehearse the landing and take-off, arms lightly forward for balance.
highlight: the calves and the muscles of the feet articulating, with the quadriceps and glutes

name: Splits: Jumping
pose: stands on the carriage and jumps, pushing the carriage away with both legs then catching it as it returns, landing softly through the balls of her feet with knees bent, arms swinging forward for balance and momentum.
highlight: the quadriceps, glutes and calves of both legs driving the jump, with the muscles of the feet

name: Advanced: Thread the Needle, Star Preparation
nameEs: Enhebrar la aguja/preparación a la estrella
pose: is on one hand and one knee on the long box with the other arm threading under her body holding a strap, one leg extended long behind her, torso twisting toward the box, hips stacked over the supporting knee.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi and abdominals, with the hip flexors and glutes of the extended leg and the shoulder of the supporting arm

name: Advanced: The Star
pose: balances on one hand and one knee on the long box with the other straight arm and the opposite straight leg both extended long out to the sides, the body opening into a five-pointed star shape.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi, abdominals, hip flexors and glutes holding the star, with both shoulders stabilising

name: Advanced: The Snake
pose: lies face down along the long box with both hands holding strap handles in front of her, then ripples her spine up into a long extending snake-like arch, chest and legs lifting as the arms sweep back and the body undulates forward and back.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi, spinal extensors and arms, with the quadriceps, shoulders and the centre

name: Advanced: Twist
pose: is seated or folded on the long box with both hands holding strap handles, rotating the whole torso around the long axis of the spine into a deep twist, the ribcage turning far past the hips while the legs stay anchored.
highlight: the obliques and quadratus lumborum through the deep twist, with the latissimus dorsi, spinal extensors and abdominals

name: Advanced: Corkscrew
pose: holds a spiralling shape on the long box with both hands on the strap handles, the torso winding around and down in a corkscrew rotation, hips and shoulders counter-rotating so the spine screws through its full length.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi and spinal extensors with the arms and quadriceps, and a deep stretch through the quadratus lumborum and obliques

name: Advanced: Balance and Control with Dismount
pose: holds a balanced pose on the reformer with her body lifted and controlled above the carriage, both hands on the strap handles and her weight poised, then steps or lowers off the machine with complete control.
highlight: the glutes, abdominals, pectorals and deltoids working together to hold the balance

name: Advanced: Opening, Backbend
pose: arches back over the reformer into a full opening backbend, hips pressing forward, chest and head reaching back and down behind her, both arms reaching long to hold the strap handles or the frame, the whole front of the body lengthening.
highlight: the glutes and lumbar extensors powering the arch, with the shoulders and arms, and a long stretch through the abdominals, hip flexors, chest and latissimus dorsi

name: Toe Dips
pose: Both knees stay bent at ninety degrees for the whole exercise — her legs never straighten and her feet never rise above her knees. She lies supine with the back of her head on the headrest and her pelvis heavy on the carriage, arms long at her sides with the palms down. Her thighs point up and her shins are horizontal, level with the floor, so both feet sit in the air just above the carriage. Her right shin tilts down a few degrees so the tip of her right big toe touches the top of the teal upholstery beside her hip, with her right knee staying bent and high, and her left leg keeps exactly the same bent shape. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the rectus abdominis down the centre of her belly, with the hip flexors at the front of her left hip

name: Arms in Straps: Triceps Press
nameEs: Brazos en las correas: press de tríceps
straps: a strap loop in each hand
pose: Her elbows are bent and pinned tight against her ribs — both upper arms lie flat on the carriage alongside her body — and only her forearms move: they point straight up at the ceiling with each hand directly above its own elbow, a black strap loop in each hand. She lies supine with the back of her head on the headrest and both knees bent to ninety degrees so her shins are horizontal and level, feet just above the carriage. She presses the straps down toward her hips while her elbows stay glued to her sides. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the triceps at the back of both upper arms

name: Arms in Straps: T Press
nameEs: Brazos en las correas: press en T
straps: a strap loop in each hand
pose: lies supine with the back of her head on the headrest and both legs in a table shape, her arms straight out wide to her sides at shoulder height so her arms and body make the shape of the letter T, palms facing up and a black strap loop in each hand. Both straight arms are sweeping down toward her hips together, caught halfway. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi on both sides of her back, with the pectorals across her chest

name: Reformer Standing Lunge
nameEs: Zancada de pie en el reformer
pose: stands in a deep lunge facing the foot end, her front foot flat on the fixed wooden platform with the front knee bent well forward over the toes, the carriage pressed far away from the platform, and her back foot behind her with its ball braced against a shoulder block on the carriage and the back heel lifted high. Her torso is upright, her back leg long, both hands resting on her front thigh. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the quadriceps and gluteals of the front leg

name: Mermaid
pose: sits side-on on the carriage with both legs folded together to one side and her hip and seat heavy on the teal upholstery. Her near hand is flat on the padded charcoal footbar and her far arm arcs up and over her head, so her torso makes one long sideways curve above the bottom hand. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the obliques on the side she bends toward, with the latissimus dorsi of the raised arm

name: Reverse Frog Kicks
straps: one strap loop on one foot
pose: lies face down along the long box with her pelvis and lower ribs supported on top of it, both hands gripping its sides, and both legs hanging off the far end. One foot is in a black strap loop with that knee bent and the heel drawn up toward her seat, and she is pressing that leg back toward straight while the other leg stays long. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the hamstrings and gluteals of the strapped leg

name: Longbox Hip Stretch
nameEs: Estiramiento de cadera en la caja larga
pose: stands in a long stride with her front foot flat on top of the long box and her back leg long behind her, the back heel lifted with the ball of the foot on the floor, both hands on her front hip. Her hips sink forward and down so the front of the back hip lengthens, and her torso stays upright. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the hip flexors at the front of the back hip

name: Longbox Hamstring Stretch
nameEs: Estiramiento de isquiotibiales en la caja larga
pose: Her raised heel rests on top of the teal padded long box and that leg is completely straight with the toes pulled back toward her. Her other foot is flat on the wooden reformer beside the box. She hinges forward from the hip over the raised leg with her back long and flat like a table and her chest open, hands reaching toward her toes. The long box is the only thing her raised leg touches, and her spine is one straight line that never rounds. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the hamstrings along the back of the raised leg

name: Longbox Shoulder Stretch
nameEs: Estiramiento de hombros en la caja larga
pose: stands behind the long box and folds forward with both hands flat on top of it, her feet walked back until her back is level and horizontal, parallel to the floor, her chest sinking down between her straight arms. Her hips stay stacked above her ankles and her weight is shared between her feet and her palms. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the latissimus dorsi on both sides of her back

name: Butterfly Stretch
straps: a strap loop on each foot
pose: lies supine with the back of her head on the headrest, both feet in black strap loops, her feet pressed together sole to sole and her knees open wide and level with her hips, out to the sides. Her sacrum is heavy and flat on the carriage and her arms rest long at her sides. She wears only a sage-green sports bra and charcoal-grey leggings: no red garment, no red band and no red fabric anywhere on her body. Any red is muscle painted on bare skin.
highlight: the adductors of the inner thighs
